page.layout: One page of running text in one column; a marginal note at the right margin beside the paragraph "Ei autem"; a short verse list below the text; a printed ornament and a printed initial F below. Page number at the head.

main_text.p: fubditi fitis. Utrimq; audiftis, quæ veftrâ- sint partium. Interea ego precor Deum, ut tas & pax sit in diebus nostris, ut ea alacres ac mosi facere possimus, quæ ad Dei gloriam il-

trandum, utilitatemq; provehendam publi- in sunt necessaria: hic deniq; annus, pluresq; sequentes alii, tranquillè, pacatè, feliciter atq; transigatur, ne pudefiamus tum, cùm talenti immissi atq; crediti reddendæ rationes nobis unt, tam magistratui, quàm subditis. Ei autem Iud. Epist.ut potest vos servare à lapsu immunes, & statuere in vers. 24. 25.conspectu gloriæ suæ inculpatos cum exsultatione: id est, sapienti Deo Servatori nostro, gloria esto & magnifi-

p.i: entia, robur & potestas, & nunc & in omnia secula, amen.

page.notes: The printed ornament at the bottom centre and the small marks along the left edge are not text. The marginal note at the right reads "Iud. Epist." and "vers. 24. 25." beside the paragraph; the printed line "ipotest" is transcribed as "ut potest" by the reading of the scan and may be doubtful. Page is partly damaged at the left edge, where some line-ends are cut off; the reading of those is uncertain.
